about.title: About us
about.heroText: Miss Chawarma is a story of cuisine, tradition and generosity, born from the desire to share an authentic, warm and vibrant Lebanon.
about.storyHeading: A place born from a passion for Lebanon
about.storyText: At Miss Chawarma, we share our passion for Lebanese cuisine through authentic and generous recipes. Inspired by tradition, we reinvent shawarma with a modern touch without ever losing its soul.
about.addressText: A welcoming destination in the heart of Rue Oberkampf.
about.homemadeText: Recipes prepared with care, freshness and generosity.
about.philosophyText: At Miss Chawarma, we favour fresh, carefully selected ingredients. We cook with precision and simplicity while respecting the authentic flavours of Lebanon.
about.valueOneText: Dishes made to be shared and memories made to last.
about.valueTwoText: Recipes inspired by Lebanon, prepared with sincerity and respect.
about.valueThreeText: Precise, generous homemade cuisine created by a passionate team.
about.galleryTitle: A place to experience as much as to taste
about.galleryText: Details, colours and a team that make every visit a warm and memorable experience.
about.socialHeading: Discover the behind-the-scenes moments, dishes and atmosphere of Miss Chawarma
about.logoHint: Hold and drag the logo. Double-click to return it to the corner.
about.socialText: Delicious moments, a passionate team and all the energy of our restaurant.

chefs.value1Text: Recipes passed down, respected and prepared with patience.
chefs.value2Text: Ingredients chosen for their freshness and character.
chefs.value3Text: Plates designed to be shared, lived and remembered.
